title: Jamaican Fritter Breakfast
description: A twist on traditional breakfast with crispy Jamaican fritters and ackee.

ingredients.name: Ackee
ingredients.notes: Canned or fresh, drained and chopped

ingredients.name: Jamaican Fritters
ingredients.notes: Crispy and nutty, store-bought or homemade

instructions: Heat butter in a pan over medium heat.
Add ackee and cook, stirring occasionally, until heated through.
Add Jamaican fritters to the pan and stir to combine with ackee.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Optional: Serve with additional Jamaican fritters on the side.
